# GCC 2.95.3 source files needed to build the ProDG stand-in cc1plus
# (powerpc-eabi cross compiler, C++ only) with tools/standin/build.py.
#
# Each line is "<sha256>  <path>", like sha256sum prints it. Paths are
# relative to the root of the GCC tree. build.py downloads each file from
# https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gcc-mirror/gcc/releases/gcc-2.95.3/
# and checks it against the sha256 of the pristine upstream file.
#
# This is every file that configure and `make cc1plus` read or check for.
# It was found by tracing a build. gcc/gcc.c is left out on purpose:
# configure only uses that name to test whether `ln -s` works.
